title: b.1.7.3 Glitch Stone slab / Crash Slab crash fix
description: A fix for the crash you get when hovering on the glitched stone slabs "crash slab" in your inventory
body:
This mod fixes the crash in inventory/chests when hovering over glitched/transmutation stone slabs from the with the full block texture.

It is a jar mod you can either put the class files in the jar or add it to multimc in the version section of your instance

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XIfam26fOvE

![crash slab](https://static.wikitide.net/modernbetawiki/thumb/a/a2/SlabDifference.png/300px-SlabDifference.png)
